svg.aria-label: Soil moisture pools in the field's low hollow
svg.title: Soil moisture pools in the field's low hollow
svg.desc: An interpolated heatmap (imshow, bilinear): a coarse soil-moisture survey grid displayed as one smooth continuous image, east-west by north-south. A deep-blue basin near the low-left is the moisture-holding hollow, the pale far corner is a free-draining ridge, and a faint blue horizontal band is a damp irrigation drip line. Colour runs pale sky (driest) to deep navy (wettest).
svg.text: Soil moisture pools in the field's low hollow
Bilinearly interpolated survey grid (imshow) · deeper blue = wetter soil · illustrative data
